scenario: Simulated Camp Fire morning in Paradise, CA. Part 1 of 2, played with audio and live transcription. Fire at Paradise High School on Maxwell Drive: east wing burns, fire comes from the north, large, 123 students and staff in the gym. Skyway gridlocked at Neal Road. Spot fires on Pearson Road. Hospital evacuation. One call is unclear on purpose (call 8).
writer_model: claude-opus-5-5 (review session, written in chat; a different model family from the extractor)

calls.text: Butte ECC, Engine 81. On scene Paradise High School, Maxwell Drive. East wing is fully involved, fire's pushing in from the north with the wind behind it. Large fire. Be advised, approximately a hundred twenty-three students and staff sheltering in the gym.
Paradise, Paradise 7. Skyway southbound is at a standstill at Neal. Nothing's moving. Start me two more units for traffic control, Skyway and Neal.
Butte ECC, Medic 41. Got an elderly female on Bille Road near Bille Park, non-ambulatory, unable to self-evac. Need a unit with a gurney, priority one.

Butte ECC, Battalion 3. Copy Paradise High School, I'll be Maxwell Command. Gym is not involved at this time. I want all hundred twenty-three occupants out before it gets there. Start me two buses to Maxwell Drive.
Battalion 3, Engine 82. Multiple spot fires along Pearson Road east of Skyway, quarter acre each and growing. We'll hold here.
Butte, Butte 12. Pentz at Wagstaff, vehicle in the ditch, two occupants, fire both sides of the roadway. No injuries at this time, need to get them out of there.
Butte ECC, Medic 44. Adventist Health Feather River is evacuating, approximately thirty patients staged at the front entrance. Need every ambulance you can send.
Butte, Engine 35, uh, we've got fire at a school, I think it's the one off Pentz? Can anybody confirm, are there still kids inside?
Paradise, Paradise 3. Clark northbound is open and moving. Recommend we push evac traffic to Clark instead of Skyway.
Butte ECC, Maxwell Command. Fire's in the east wing roof now, wind shifted, coming out of the northeast. Occupants still in the gym. What's the ETA on those buses?

style: Real radio conventions: dispatch called by name (Butte ECC), clear text, copy, start me, short cross-street phrases.
